name: dumbbell incline one arm front raise with chest support
description: Front raise with your chest supported on an incline bench to reduce swinging. It isolates the front delts.
instructions: Set an incline bench and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
